name: Scintillate
description: Gray grid lines on a dark ground with a pale dot at every crossing, the dots swelling a little toward the middle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((8 + 5 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((8 + 5 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((8 + 5 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((8 + 5 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
